name: Spirit Lantern

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Reference entry; bespoke effects require manual resolution. Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Reference-only: A hovering lantern sheds Dim Light 60 feet and captures fragments when enemies die in that light, up to your spellcasting modifier. Bonus Action spends a fragment on a visible creature within 60 feet: Constitution save against 4d8 + spellcasting modifier Necrotic (half on success), heal an Undead for that amount, or impose Disadvantage on incoming attacks until your next turn starts. Fragments vanish when the spell ends.
